name: Gobernación de Nariño
body: Share cards are complete, the sitemap and structured data are valid, and HSTS runs a full year. But the home page HTML alone is about 900 KB, still 150 KB compressed, before any image or script loads.
lesson: Move inline data and repeated markup out of the HTML, and page long lists.
summary: narino.gov.co scores 65 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 28 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 85 images have no alt attribute.

fix.title: 85 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 1 internal link leads to an error
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 19 pages read.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /tramites-y-servicios/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 19 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /transparencia-y-acceso-a-la-informacion-publica/, /tramites-y-servicios/, /normatividad/ and 15 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 19 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
